chapter.v:
“On that
day you will call your brothers Ammi, and you will call your sisters Ruhamah.
chapter.heading: Wild Weekends and Unholy Holidays
chapter.v:
Condemn your
mother, condemn her because she is not my wife and I am not her husband. Tell her to stop looking like a prostitute—get rid of the makeup and the provocative clothing.

Otherwise I
will strip her naked as the day she was born, and make her like a desert, a barren land, and let her die of thirst.

I will
have no pity on her children, because they are children of prostitution.

For their
mother was a prostitute who conceived them in a shameful way. She said, ‘I'll run after my lovers who give me my food and water, my wool and flax and olive oil, and my drink.’

That is
why I am going to block her path with thorn bushes, and build a stone wall to stop her so she won't find her way.

When she
runs after her lovers she won't catch up with them; she'll look for them but she won't find them. Then she'll say, ‘Let me go back to my former husband, because it was better for me then than now.’

She doesn't
consider that it was me who gave her grain, new wine, and olive oil, nor the silver and the gold which I gave her abundantly that they made into an idol of Baal.

So I
will take back my ripened grain and my new wine I gave at harvest-time. I will take back my wool and my flax I provided to cover her nakedness.

I will
strip her naked while her lovers watch; no one will be able to rescue her from me.

I will
put a stop to all her festivities: her feasts, new moon celebrations, special Sabbaths—all her festivals.

I will
destroy her vines and fig trees that she said were given to her as payment for being a prostitute. I will turn them into scrub-land; only wild animals will eat the remaining fruit.

I will
punish her for all the times she offered incense to Baal, dressing herself up, putting on rings and jewelry, going after her lovers, but forgetting about me, declares the Lord.
chapter.heading: To Start All Over Again
chapter.v:
See what
I'm going to do! I will win her back, taking her into the desert where I will speak to her heart-to-heart.

There I
will return her vineyards to her and make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will respond to me as she did when she was young, as in the time when she left the land of Egypt.

Then on
that day, says the Lord, you will call me ‘my husband’ and not ‘my Baal.’

I will
stop her appealing to the Baals—their names won't be mentioned ever again.

At that
time I will make a solemn agreement with the wild animals and the birds of the sky and the creeping things of the ground. I will do away with the bow and the sword; I will abolish war from the land so you can lie down in safety.

I will
make you my wife forever; I will make you my wife in goodness and justice and love and mercy.

I will
be faithful to you, my wife, and you will know me as the Lord.

On that
day, declares the Lord, I will answer the heavens and they will answer the earth.

The earth
will answer the grain, and the new wine, and the olive oil, and they shall answer, ‘Jezreel’ (God sows).

I will
‘sow’ her for myself in the earth. I will love Lo-ruhamah (unloved) and I will say ‘You are my people’ to Lo-ammi (not my people), and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
